title: 茶水間閒聊
subtitle: 12 句英文，跟同事聊天不冷場

lines.say: Morning! How are things?
lines.zh: 早安！最近怎麼樣？

lines.say: Good.
lines.zh: 很好。

lines.say: …Right. Well. Enjoy your coffee.
lines.zh: ……好吧，那，好好享用你的咖啡。

lines.say: That was me, my first week at work. Good. Fine. Yes. And then silence.
lines.zh: 這是我上班第一週。Good、Fine、Yes，然後一片沉默。

lines.say: Small talk isn't about big topics. It's about keeping the ball in the air.
lines.zh: 閒聊不是講大道理，而是讓球一直在空中，不要掉下來。

lines.say: Hi everyone, I'm Neev! Today: twelve sentences for small talk with your colleagues.
lines.zh: 哈囉大家，我是 Niamh 老師！今天教你跟同事閒聊的十二句話。
lines.cap: Hi everyone, I'm Niamh! Today: twelve sentences for small talk with your colleagues.

lines.say: How to start, how to keep it going, how to find things in common, and how to leave without being awkward.
lines.zh: 怎麼開場、怎麼接話、怎麼找共同點，還有怎麼不尷尬地離開。

scenes.title: Start
scenes.sub: 開場：一句話打開話匣子

lines.say: Part one: start the chat.
lines.zh: 第一段：打開話題。

lines.say: The best openers are easy to answer. Nobody wants a hard question before coffee.
lines.zh: 最好的開場很好回答。沒人想在喝咖啡前回答難題。

scenes.label: No. 1
scenes.phrase: Have you got anything nice planned for the weekend?
scenes.meaning: 週末有安排什麼好玩的嗎？

lines.say: Have you got anything nice planned for the weekend?
This works from Wednesday to Friday. Everyone has an answer, even if it's: nothing!
lines.zh: 從週三到週五都能用。每個人都答得出來，就算答案是「沒有」！

lines.say: Anything nice makes it friendly, not nosy.
lines.zh: anything nice 讓問題很友善，不會像在打探。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Have you got anything nice planned for the weekend?

scenes.label: No. 2
scenes.phrase: How was your weekend? Did you get up to much?
scenes.meaning: 週末過得怎樣？有做什麼嗎？
scenes.note: get up to ＝ 做（什麼事）

lines.say: And on Monday, turn it around.
lines.zh: 到了週一，就反過來問。

lines.say: How was your weekend? Did you get up to much?
Get up to means do. Did you get up to much? means: did you do anything fun?
lines.zh: get up to 是做。Did you get up to much? 是「有做什麼好玩的嗎？」

lines.say: Very common in Ireland and the UK. It sounds relaxed and natural.
lines.zh: 在愛爾蘭和英國超常見，聽起來輕鬆自然。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: How was your weekend? Did you get up to much?

scenes.label: No. 3
scenes.phrase: Is it just me, or is this week dragging?
scenes.meaning: 是我的錯覺嗎，還是這週過得特別慢？

lines.say: Or start with a shared feeling.
lines.zh: 或者用一個大家都有的感覺開場。

lines.say: Is it just me, or is this week dragging?
Is it just me, or invites the other person to agree with you.
lines.zh: Is it just me, or 邀請對方附和你。

lines.say: Dragging means time is moving slowly. Everyone agrees on a Thursday!
lines.zh: dragging 是時間過很慢。週四大家一定都同意！

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Is it just me, or is this week dragging?
Part two: keep it going.
lines.zh: 第二段：把話接下去。

lines.say: The secret: answer, add one detail, and ask something back.
lines.zh: 秘訣是：回答、多加一個細節，再反問一句。

scenes.label: No. 4
scenes.phrase: Not much, to be honest. I just took it easy. What about you?
scenes.meaning: 老實說沒什麼，就放輕鬆。你呢？
scenes.note: take it easy ＝ 放輕鬆、休息

lines.say: Not much, to be honest. I just took it easy. What about you?
Even a boring weekend can keep the chat alive. The magic is in: what about you?
lines.zh: 就算週末很無聊也能讓話題繼續，魔法就在 what about you。

lines.say: Take it easy means rest and relax. A perfectly good weekend!
lines.zh: take it easy 是休息放鬆，很棒的週末啊！

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Not much, to be honest. I just took it easy. What about you?

scenes.label: No. 5
scenes.phrase: Oh, really? How did that go?
scenes.note: How did that go? ＝ 結果怎麼樣？

lines.say: When they tell you something, show interest.
lines.zh: 對方說了什麼，就表示有興趣。

lines.say: Oh, really? How did that go?
How did that go? asks for the story. People love telling their story.
lines.zh: How did that go? 是請對方講故事，大家都喜歡講自己的事。

lines.say: Say oh, really? with your eyebrows up. It shows you're listening.
lines.zh: 說 oh, really? 時挑一下眉毛，表示你有在聽。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: Oh, really? How did that go?

scenes.label: No. 6
scenes.phrase: I've been meaning to try that place. Is it any good?
scenes.meaning: 我一直想去那家，好吃嗎？
scenes.note: have been meaning to ＝ 一直想要（但還沒做）

lines.say: And connect it to yourself.
lines.zh: 再把話題連到你自己。

lines.say: I've been meaning to try that place. Is it any good?
I've been meaning to means: I wanted to for a while, but I haven't yet.
lines.zh: I've been meaning to 是想很久了，但還沒去做。

lines.say: Now they're the expert. They'll tell you everything.
lines.zh: 現在對方變專家了，會全部告訴你。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I've been meaning to try that place. Is it any good?
Let's try that morning again.
lines.zh: 我們重來一次那個早上。

lines.say: Morning! How are things?
lines.zh: 早安！最近怎麼樣？

lines.say: Not bad, thanks. How was your weekend? Did you get up to much?
lines.zh: 還不錯，謝謝。週末過得怎樣？有做什麼嗎？

lines.say: We tried that new Spanish place on Dame Street.
lines.zh: 我們去了 Dame Street 那家新的西班牙餐廳。

lines.say: Oh, really? How did that go? I've been meaning to try that place.
lines.zh: 喔，真的嗎？結果怎麼樣？我一直想去那家。

lines.say: Honestly, my mum makes better paella. But the dessert was amazing!
lines.zh: 老實說，我媽做的海鮮飯比較好吃。不過甜點超棒！

lines.say: See? Now it's a real conversation.
lines.zh: 看到了嗎？現在是真正的對話了。

scenes.title: Common ground
scenes.sub: 找共同點：從同事變朋友

lines.say: Part three: find things in common.
lines.zh: 第三段：找共同點。

lines.say: This is where colleagues start becoming friends.
lines.zh: 同事就是從這裡開始變朋友的。

scenes.label: No. 7
scenes.phrase: Have you been watching anything good lately?
scenes.meaning: 最近有在看什麼好看的嗎？

lines.say: Have you been watching anything good lately?
TV is the safest topic in any office. Everyone watches something.
lines.zh: 影集是辦公室裡最安全的話題，每個人都在看點什麼。

lines.say: If you've seen it too, you've found something in common!
lines.zh: 如果你也看過，你們就有共同話題了！

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Have you been watching anything good lately?

scenes.label: No. 8
scenes.phrase: How long have you been working here, by the way?
scenes.meaning: 對了，你在這裡工作多久了？
scenes.note: by the way ＝ 對了、順便問一下

lines.say: Then ask about them.
lines.zh: 接著問問對方的事。

lines.say: How long have you been working here, by the way?
By the way lets you change the topic smoothly.
lines.zh: by the way 讓你自然地換話題。

lines.say: And people who've been there longer always have useful tips.
lines.zh: 待比較久的人總是有很多實用的建議。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: How long have you been working here, by the way?

scenes.label: No. 9
scenes.phrase: We should grab lunch together some time.
scenes.meaning: 我們找時間一起吃午餐吧
scenes.note: grab lunch ＝ 一起吃個午餐（輕鬆說法）

lines.say: And when it's going well, take the next step.
lines.zh: 聊得順的時候，就再往前一步。

lines.say: We should grab lunch together some time.
Grab lunch sounds casual. No pressure, just food.
lines.zh: grab lunch 聽起來很隨性，沒有壓力，就是吃個飯。

lines.say: Some time keeps it open. If they say: how about Thursday? You've made a friend!
lines.zh: some time 讓時間保持彈性。如果對方說「週四怎麼樣？」你就交到朋友了！

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: We should grab lunch together some time.
Part four: leave the chat without being awkward.
lines.zh: 第四段：不尷尬地結束聊天。

lines.say: Every chat has to end. The trick is to end it warmly.
lines.zh: 每段聊天都要結束，訣竅是溫暖地結束。

scenes.label: No. 10
scenes.phrase: Anyway, I'd better get back to it.

lines.say: Anyway, I'd better get back to it.
Anyway signals the end. I'd better get back to it means: back to work for me.
lines.zh: anyway 是結束的信號。I'd better get back to it 是「我要回去工作了」。

lines.say: Nobody is offended. Everybody has work.
lines.zh: 沒人會不開心，大家都有工作。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Anyway, I'd better get back to it.

scenes.label: No. 11
scenes.phrase: I'll let you get on with your day.
scenes.note: get on with ＝ 繼續做（某事）

lines.say: Or make it about them. Even more polite.
lines.zh: 或者把重點放在對方，更有禮貌。

lines.say: I'll let you get on with your day.
I'll let you get on means: I won't take more of your time.
lines.zh: I'll let you get on 意思是：我不再佔用你的時間。

lines.say: It sounds kind, like you're doing them a favour.
lines.zh: 聽起來很體貼，好像是在幫對方的忙。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: I'll let you get on with your day.

scenes.label: No. 12
scenes.phrase: Good chatting to you. Catch you later!
scenes.meaning: 很高興跟你聊天，待會見！
scenes.note: Catch you later ＝ 待會見（輕鬆說法）

lines.say: And the last line, with a smile.
lines.zh: 最後一句，帶著微笑說。

lines.say: Good chatting to you. Catch you later!
Good chatting to you is the friendly goodbye for colleagues.
lines.zh: Good chatting to you 是同事間友善的道別。

lines.say: Catch you later is relaxed. You'll see each other again at the coffee machine!
lines.zh: Catch you later 很輕鬆，反正等一下在咖啡機又會遇到！

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Good chatting to you. Catch you later!
Have you been watching anything good lately?
lines.zh: 最近有在看什麼好看的嗎？

lines.say: I've just started that Irish crime drama. I can't stop!
lines.zh: 我剛開始看那部愛爾蘭犯罪劇，停不下來！

lines.say: No way, me too! We should grab lunch together some time and talk about it.
lines.zh: 不會吧，我也是！我們找時間一起吃午餐聊這部。

lines.say: Definitely. How about Thursday?
lines.zh: 當然好。週四怎麼樣？

lines.say: Perfect. Anyway, I'd better get back to it. Good chatting to you. Catch you later!
lines.zh: 太好了。好啦，我該回去忙了。很高興跟你聊天，待會見！

lines.say: Lunch on Thursday. From good to a new friend in one week.
lines.zh: 週四吃午餐。一週內從「Good」變成新朋友。

scenes.title: Only in Ireland
scenes.sub: 愛爾蘭限定：茶水間的兩句

lines.say: One more thing! Two Irish lines you'll hear by the kettle.
lines.zh: 還有加碼！在熱水壺旁邊常聽到的兩句愛爾蘭話。

lines.say: Irish people often say this instead of how are you.
lines.zh: 愛爾蘭人常用這句代替 how are you。

lines.say: Any news?
It doesn't mean the news on TV. It means: what's new with you?
lines.zh: 這不是在問電視新聞，是「你最近有什麼新鮮事？」

lines.say: And when someone asks how you are, try this answer.
lines.zh: 別人問你好不好時，試試這個回答。

lines.say: Not a bother on me.
It means: I'm perfectly fine, nothing is wrong. Very relaxed, very Irish.
lines.zh: 意思是：我好得很，什麼事都沒有。很輕鬆，很愛爾蘭。

lines.say: Not a bother on me.

scenes.title: All together
scenes.sub: 總複習：一次完整的茶水間閒聊

lines.say: Now the whole chat, from hello to goodbye. Say my lines!
lines.zh: 現在把整段閒聊從打招呼到道別演一遍。跟我一起唸！

lines.say: Morning, Niamh! Any news?
lines.zh: 早安，Niamh！最近有什麼新鮮事嗎？

lines.say: Not a bother on me. Is it just me, or is this week dragging?
lines.zh: 我好得很。是我的錯覺嗎，還是這週過得特別慢？

lines.say: It's not just you! I can't wait for Friday.
lines.zh: 不只你這樣覺得！我等不及週五了。

lines.say: Have you got anything nice planned for the weekend?
lines.zh: 週末有安排什麼好玩的嗎？

lines.say: I'm going to Galway with my sister.
lines.zh: 我要跟我妹妹去 Galway。

lines.say: Oh, really? Lovely. Well, I'll let you get on with your day. Catch you later!
lines.zh: 喔，真的嗎？真好。那不打擾你了，你去忙吧。待會見！

lines.say: Lovely! You kept the ball in the air the whole time.
lines.zh: 太棒了！你讓球一直在空中，沒有掉下來。

lines.say: Here are all twelve. Screenshot them, and try one at the coffee machine tomorrow.
lines.zh: 十二句都在這裡。截圖下來，明天在咖啡機旁試一句。

board.cta: 打開 BinBin，每天用一則新聞練英文

lines.say: I'm Neev. Open BinBin, and practise English with one news story every day.
lines.zh: 我是 Niamh 老師。打開 BinBin，每天用一則新聞練英文。
lines.cap: I'm Niamh. Open BinBin, and practise English with one news story every day.

lines.say: Then you'll always have an answer to: any news? See you next time. Bye!
lines.zh: 這樣別人問 any news? 你永遠答得出來。下一課見，Bye！
